name: Bunny and Raffles in: The Ides of March
source:
Be gay and do crime in Victorian London in this new way to experience E.W Hornung's 1898 short story-- a contemporary counterpart to Sherlock Holmes.

The Ides of March is the first of a series of crime adventure stories starring the hapless and sweet tempered 'Bunny' Manders, and his daring, manic former schoolmate AJ Raffles, who drags him into a glorious and dangerous life of criminal sin.

[From [url=https://doctorcorby.itch.io/bunny-and-raffles-in-the-ides-of-march]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
到维多利亚时代的伦敦，和同性相恋，和情人一道犯案！E. W. 霍纳1898年发表的短篇小说与福尔摩斯故事诞生于同一时代，如今你可以换个方式，亲身走进故事。

《三月十五日》是一系列犯罪冒险故事的开篇。主角之一是性情温和却老是走背运的“兔子”曼德斯。另一位是他的老同学A. J. 莱佛士。此人胆大得近乎疯狂，硬是拉着曼德斯，一同踏上了风光又危险的犯罪生涯。

［摘自[url=https://doctorcorby.itch.io/bunny-and-raffles-in-the-ides-of-march]itch.io[/url]］
